title: Vibrant Crunchy Basque French Doner Meat Boeuf Bourguignon
description: A malty, crunchy, weeknight French dish featuring doner meat, cooked in a clay pot, low-fat-friendly, in the form of boeuf bourguignon. This recipe is a unique twist on traditional boeuf bourguignon.
instructions: Heat the clay pot over medium heat and add the chopped onion, cooking until it is translucent.
Add the chopped carrot and celery and cook until they are tender.
Add the thinly sliced doner meat and cook until it is browned.
Add the malt vinegar, red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, and thyme, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the boeuf bourguignon hot, garnished with fresh thyme.
Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving.
